meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 帮你按指定时间范围（默认过去7天）在飞书里找出所有会议，汇总每场会议的纪要文档和逐字稿链接，整理成“今日会议概览”或“会议纪要周报”一类的结构化报告；你要求时还能把报告写入飞书云文档。
howto.when: 当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间的会议内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: Claude 会生成这周的会议纪要周报。

say.text: 总结一下今天开了哪些会
say.note: Claude 会汇总今天的会议概览。

say.text: 把过去7天的会议纪要整理成文档
say.note: Claude 会生成报告并写入飞书云文档。

howto.what_en: Finds all meetings in a given time range (default: past 7 days) on Feishu, gathers minutes and transcript links, and produces a structured report (single-day overview or weekly summary). Can also write it to a Feishu cloud doc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to organize meeting minutes, generate a weekly summary, or review meetings from a period.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting minutes.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the weekly minutes report.
Claude will create today's meeting overview.

say_en.text: Compile the past 7 days of minutes into a document.
say_en.note: Claude will produce the report and write it to a Feishu cloud doc.
